title: Turkeyfoot Lake Golf Links
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Turkeyfoot Lake Golf Links is the first and the finest public golf course in the Akron area, located in scenic Portage Lakes. We are in country club shape while offering public prices. We are the dryest course in the area and always let out our carts, even when some other courses may be closed due to wetness.
